input.heading: Safety culture
input.text: The organization shall establish, foster and sustain a safety culture that supports the achievement of functional safety.

expected.summary: The organization shall establish and sustain a safety culture supporting functional safety.

input.heading: Independent review
input.text: The review should be performed by a person who was not responsible for producing the reviewed work product.

expected.summary: An independent person should review the work product.

input.heading: hazard
input.text: Potential source of harm caused by malfunctioning behaviour of the item.

expected.summary: A hazard is a potential source of harm caused by malfunctioning item behaviour.
